risk_title: Emergency Recall Collapse Under Safety Constraint
impact: Over 80-90% of actual life-threatening emergency vocalizations are missed (False Negatives).
reproducibility: 100% reproducible across 5 outer folds and 15 speakers
current_mitigation: Rejected for emergency deployment; formal status SAFETY-INFEASIBLE.
required_fix: Acoustic feature fine-tuning, dysarthric phonetic adaptation, or multimodal sensor integration.

risk_title: Depressed Emergency Precision and High False Alarm Burden
impact: Emergency precision is 7.45% - 8.98%. Over 91% of alerts triggered by the system are false alarms, causing alert fatigue and 911 dispatch saturation.
current_mitigation: Hierarchical Stage 1 gate reduces false alarm rate relative to flat baseline, but burden remains prohibitive.
required_fix: Increase discriminative score separation between general speech strain and emergency intent.

impact: Severe dysarthric speakers (e.g. MC04, M02) account for 49.5% of all false alarms, exceeding allowable FER by more than 1.9x.
current_mitigation: Per-speaker thresholding demonstrated in Phase 8.1, but requires adaptation data per speaker.
required_fix: Enrollment calibration procedure for each dysarthric user prior to operational deployment.

risk_title: Complete Absence of Independent Confirmation Data
impact: Model generalization to unseen atypical speech populations is unconfirmed. All TORGO data are contaminated by training or diagnostic audits.
current_mitigation: Phase 8.2 confirmation status permanently frozen as BLOCKED.
required_fix: Execute prospective clinical cohort data collection or acquire external UASpeech corpus under DUA.

impact: Phase 8.2 protocol cited checkpoints/phase8_1/*.pt, but weights were never persisted to disk.
current_mitigation: Phase 8.2.1 protocol v2 marks checkpoint references as UNMATERIALIZED and blocks execution.
required_fix: Serialize and cryptographically hash candidate model binaries under an authorized development protocol.
blocks_gate: Gate B, Gate C, Gate D

risk_title: Quantum Simulation Latency Precludes Real-Time Inference
impact: Exact statevector quantum simulation is 772.6x slower per evaluation (~1.08s per sample) than classical RBF-SVM (0.0014s).
current_mitigation: Classical adapter baseline is available with < 2ms latency.
required_fix: Use classical adapter for real-time edge processing; restrict quantum models to asynchronous research analysis.

risk_title: Demo Server Concurrency and Authentication Absence
impact: scripts/run_app_demo.py runs Python's built-in single-threaded http.server without TLS, auth, or session persistence.
current_mitigation: Scoped strictly to local single-user research demonstration.
required_fix: Implement FastAPI / Uvicorn with JWT auth and HTTPS for any network-accessible deployment.
